status_definitions.REJECTED: Training, cost, stability or validation screen fails.
status_definitions.INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE: Too little evidence for a meaningful conclusion.
status_definitions.DEVELOPMENT_CANDIDATE: Passed a limited screen on development data.
status_definitions.PAPER_PENDING: Locked version collecting new forward evidence.
status_definitions.FRESH_VALIDATED: Passed the predeclared evaluation on genuinely new data.

notes: A symbol-level pooled screen is not a statistical approval of its 12 monthly strategies. live_approved stays FALSE everywhere. The pooled configuration passes ONLY development_screen_passed: its CI includes losses and its 5-pip cost result is negative.
